title: Compounds
competency: Define a compound as two or more elements chemically combined.

keywords.def: A pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined.

en.text: A compound is a pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined. Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen. Each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. Salt, carbon dioxide and sugar are also compounds.

screens.title: Table salt
screens.ask: Table salt is made of sodium and chlorine joined together. Is salt an element?
screens.after:
Salt can be broken into sodium and chlorine, so it is not an element.
It has two elements chemically combined.
A substance like this is a compound.

screens.title: 3.2.1 Compounds
paras: A compound is a pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined.
Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
Each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

screens.title: Examples of compounds
paras: Examples: sodium chloride, iron sulfide, carbon dioxide, sugar, calcium carbonate and calcium oxide.

screens.title: What is each compound made of?
screens.ask: Tap each compound to see its elements.
items: Sodium + chlorine. This is table salt.
Carbon + oxygen. We breathe it out.
Calcium + carbon + oxygen. Limestone is made of it.
Calcium + oxygen. It is called quicklime.

screens.title: Elements and compounds: what do they share?
sets: One kind of atom. Cannot be broken down by ordinary chemical means. Example: gold.
Two or more elements chemically combined. Can be broken into its elements. Example: water.
overlaps: Both are pure substances. Each has its own name and symbol or formula.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined.

opts: A pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined
A pure substance with one kind of atom
Two substances mixed but not joined
screens.ans: A pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined
screens.why:
A compound is a pure substance.
It has two or more elements.
The elements are chemically combined (joined).
"One kind of atom" describes an element.
"Mixed but not joined" describes a mixture.
screens.clue: How many elements are in a compound?

screens.title: Element or compound?
screens.why:
Count the kinds of element in each substance.
Gold and oxygen: one kind of atom each → elements.
Sodium chloride: sodium + chlorine → compound.
Water: hydrogen + oxygen → compound.
Carbon dioxide: carbon + oxygen → compound.
screens.text: Sort each substance: element or compound?

screens.ask: Count the atoms in a water molecule: two hydrogen atoms and ___ oxygen atom.
screens.why:
Water's formula is H₂O.
The 2 after H means two hydrogen atoms.
O has no number, so there is one oxygen atom.
Answer: one.
screens.clue: Look at the book sentence about water.

screens.text: True or false: a compound is a pure substance.
screens.why:
A compound is made of two or more elements.
The elements are chemically combined.
The book calls a compound a pure substance.
The statement is true.

screens.text: Calcium oxide is made from calcium and oxygen. Which statement about it is right?
opts: It is an element because it is pure
It is a compound: two elements chemically combined
It is a mixture of two gases
screens.ans: It is a compound: two elements chemically combined
screens.why:
Calcium oxide is pure, but pure does not always mean element.
It has two elements: calcium and oxygen.
They are chemically combined.
So calcium oxide is a compound.
It is not a mixture of gases: calcium is a metal.
screens.clue: Pure does not always mean element.

test.text: Which of these substances is a compound?
test.why:
Gold, oxygen and iron each have one kind of atom: elements.
Water has hydrogen and oxygen combined.
Answer: water.

test.text: True or false: a compound has only one kind of atom.
test.why:
A compound has two or more elements.
So it has two or more kinds of atom.
Only an element has one kind of atom.
The statement is false.

test.text: Which elements make up water? Water is a compound of
test.why:
Water's formula is H₂O.
H is hydrogen; O is oxygen.
Carbon and oxygen make carbon dioxide instead.
Answer: hydrogen and oxygen.

test.text: Tap every substance that is a compound.
test.why:
Sugar: carbon, hydrogen and oxygen → compound.
Iron sulfide: iron and sulfur → compound.
Calcium carbonate: calcium, carbon and oxygen → compound.
Silver and nitrogen have one kind of atom → elements.

test.text: Iron sulfide can be broken down into iron and sulfur. What kind of substance is iron sulfide?
test.why:
Iron sulfide breaks down into two elements.
An element cannot be broken down.
So iron sulfide is two elements chemically combined.
Answer: a compound.
